pattern.label: Default tracks pattern (checkpoint → station mapping)
pattern.hint: Assigns each checkpoint to a station/balise. Create tracks patterns in the Patterns page. The mapping is shown per checkpoint below. Overridable at launch.

checkpoints.perCheckpoint: Per checkpoint (each has its own icon)

routes.hint: Operators pick one of the enabled routes at launch time.

displays.hint: Operators pick one of the enabled display modes at launch time.

full.label: Full
full.help: Map + checkpoint title, description, and reveal image with animation.

map.label: Map
map.help: Map only; markers light up on hit. No title/description, no big reveal.

simple.label: Simple
simple.help: Minimal HUD (team name + score + current checkpoint number), no map.

playModes.hint: Operators pick one of the enabled play modes at launch time.

itinerary.label: Itinerary
itinerary.help: Teams must hit checkpoints in order.

scoreTypes.hint: Operators pick one of the enabled score types at launch. The one marked "default" is pre-selected.

percentage.label: Percentage
percentage.help: Score = % of checkpoints hit, capped at 100, minus time malus.

points.label: Points
points.help: Score = sum of points across hit checkpoints, minus time malus.

displayOptions.displayScoreHint: Show the running score in the HUD throughout the game.

textElements.noElements: No elements in this category yet.
textElements.hint: Categories group text elements + define their typography defaults (font, color, bold / italic / underline, align, shadow, background). Typography is edited in the layout editor; per-element overrides win per field.
textElements.deleteConfirmWithElements_one: Delete category "{{name}}"? Its {{count}} element will move to Uncategorized.
textElements.deleteConfirmWithElements_other: Delete category "{{name}}"? Its {{count}} elements will move to Uncategorized.
